## Reconciled Scope And Consumption

G is the sole first landing lane for shared native construction/location,
canonical event record, lifecycle event counts, semantic-event/hash evidence,
latest agent-delivery status, served delivery/debug, application snapshot,
historical capture and the transferred shared private dependencies. C owns
physical receiver evidence and its reserved receipt/fixed-history/event-key
extensions. None of those introductions lands in this PR. The inherited
agent-delivery waiter and its DB argument remain unchanged and G-owned.
B does not create an alternative generic read helper, validator or constructor.

Retained private operations bind the existing native backend RunReadTransaction
directly, without exporting a callback or recovering a pool. Existing
StartPostgresRuntimeStoreWithReopen is consumed unchanged by workflow/tool
construction. No new construction/lifetime, mutation or transaction policy
is introduced. All selected owners are the originals, including the two
closed fault wrappers' embedded native owners.
